item.title: gopls vs rust-analyzer vs clangd vs pyright in 2026: Which Language Server Actually Keeps Up?
item.description: Your editor feels slow and you blame the theme. It is almost never the theme. It is the language server: a background process that parses your repository, resolves types, and streams diagnostics over JSON-RPC. When it is healthy, go-to-definition is instant. When it is not, every keystroke queues behind a full re-index of a 400,000-line workspace.
